spec.goal: Fix verify.py crash on no spec + add hooks deployment to install.py

plan.description: Fix verify.py to gracefully handle missing spec
Add hooks/ copy and PreToolUse config to install.py

changes.description: Wrap run_verification() in try/except SpecNotFoundError, exit 0 with message

reason.because: Stop hook runs verify.py after every session, but no spec exists between tasks
reason.therefore: Gracefully exit with informational message instead of crashing

changes.description: Add hooks/ directory copy + PreToolUse hook config to install_workflow()

reason.because: Other repos need the confirmation gate (check_spec.py) deployed automatically
reason.therefore: install.py now copies hooks/ dir and registers PreToolUse hook in settings.json

reasoning_chain.observation: Stop hook crashes with SpecNotFoundError when no task is active
reasoning_chain.because: verify.py calls load_spec() unconditionally, which raises if file missing
reasoning_chain.therefore: Added try/except at __main__ level to catch SpecNotFoundError and exit 0

reasoning_chain.observation: install.py only deployed Stop hook, not PreToolUse confirmation gate
reasoning_chain.because: The hooks/ directory and PreToolUse config were added after initial install.py
reasoning_chain.therefore: Added hooks/ copytree and PreToolUse entry to settings.json generation

tests.name: verify.py no-spec graceful exit
tests.output: No active spec — nothing to verify.

next_steps: Re-install workflow to TokenMonitor and LifeCopilot to deploy hooks
